title: Read: which Atari game?
summary: With no tools and no candidate list, Claude Opus 5.5 named the right Atari game from the raw weights in 14/20 main attempts and 6/8 hidden-unit-permuted attempts. Three games met the pre-registered bar (≥ 3/5 and not a default guess): Breakout, Pong and Freeway, so the verdict is "reads game identity from weights". Ms. Pac-Man was 0/5. The most common answer was Breakout (9/28), below the default-guess threshold. Both random-init controls (2/2) were called untrained. API cost $5.93.

table.caption: Correct / attempts per network, no tools, no candidate list; grading pre-registered in experiments/exp1/GRADING.md. Specificity = how often this game was the answer on the other three networks' main attempts (it must be ≤ 5/15 for the game to count as read).

After any real training they would almost certainly drift off zero, at least by enough to show at 0.001 resolution. Exact zeros everywhere are the signature of initialization.

2. **The output layer is tiny and has no structure.** W3 entries are integers between about −4 and +4, so actual values of roughly ±0.004.
